title: Social Advertising Effectiveness Across Products: A Large-Scale Field Experiment
authors: Shan Huang; Sinan Aral; Yu Jeffrey Hu; Erik Brynjolfsson
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment on a Tencent social network (social-cue vs no-cue ads over three weeks, Dec 2015-Jan 2016) comparing ads with and without social cues; user-ad-level logit models of clicks with treatment x product-type interactions. No staggered adoption and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: code_files/table_4.do and table_5_*.do: logit first_has_click sc c.sc#c.experience c.sc#c.status ... i.adid i.weekx demographics, vce(cluster publishid); Appendix B tables similar.
data_files_note: README: Tencent NDA; simulated data with the same structure as the real data.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
